---
name: Improvement proposal
about: Suggest a focused workflow or learning improvement
title: "Proposal: "
labels: enhancement
---

## User problem

Who needs this, and in which specific task?

## Proposed behaviour

Give a concrete fictional before/after example.

## Acceptance criteria

How can a reviewer check that the change works?

## Source and scope

For regulatory content, provide an official URL, publication/update date and relevant section. Separate source requirements from your proposed design choice.

## Limits and verification

What remains outside the feature's scope? What meaningful software checks are needed?
